decision_conditions:
<p>The
proposed
development, by reason of the proposed housing mix, specifically the absence of
a three (3)-bed unit, and its location with poor access to public transport would
fail to achieve an appropriate housing mix having regard to the location of the
site and its surroundings, as well as evidence of local need which identifies a
need for larger family-sized units. The proposed development would therefore
fail to contribute to the creation of inclusive and mixed communities, contrary
to the provisions of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies H1
and H10 of the London Plan (2021) and Policies HO1A and HO1B and HO2(1) of the
Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">A
Preliminary Ecological Appraisal is absent from the planning application
submission material, which is required prior to determination. In the absence
of such ecological information, the Local Planning Authority is unable to ascertain
with confidence that the proposal would not have an adverse impact on a species
protected by Section 41 of the Natural Environmental and Rural Communities Act
2006 (NERC), the Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations (2019), Schedules
1, 5 and 8 of the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981 (as amended), the ODPM Circular
06/2005: Biodiversity and Geological Conservation – Statutory Obligations and
their impact within the Planning System, and would therefore be contrary to
Paragraph 187 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policy G6 of
the London Plan (2021) and Strategic Policy 07 and Policy GI 3 of the Harrow
Local Plan (2021-2041).<o:p></o:p></p>

<p>The proposed development, by reason of the proposed subdivision of the rear garden into three separate amenity spaces, would result in a form of development which would be out of keeping with the prevailing character and appearance of the local area predominantly comprising of large detached family dwellinghouses and rear gardens, and given its siting to a corner, would be especially visible and detract from the appearance of the property, contrary to Policies GR1 and HO2(g) of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</p>
description: Conversion of dwelling into three flats (1 X 1 bed and 2 X 2 beds); single storey front extension incorporating front porch; single and two storey side extension; single storey rear extension; alterations and extension to roof to form rear dormer; roof lights in front and side roof slopes; separate amenity space; landscaping; parking; bin and cycle stores; external alterations (Demolition of attached garage and rear store)
